title: Unique First Exit Time
statement: Let $k,n$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $\mathrm{tr}$ be a transition rule for $n+1$ states, optional input bits, and $k$ work-tape reads, and let $c$ be a configuration with state $q$. Let $d$ be an augmented configuration at the round machine's entry state that represents $c$ and the transition rule. There is a unique positive time $T$ at which the round machine is in either its entry state or its halt state; at every strictly intermediate positive time it is in neither state.
hypotheses_covered: state q among the n+1 states
d is at the round machine entry state
d represents c with respect to tr
